note: SRA on Bone Creek off US 183 north of Long Pine, NE of Ainsworth. 25 electric pads (sites 1-25) in two rows off the park road, plus 10 basic sites (26-35) in the south-west loop and primitive camping. Fire grates and picnic tables; water pump, primitive restrooms and a dump station. Stocked ponds in the park. Self-pay iron ranger (cash or check). --Claude
